prerequisites.en: Unit Operations and Basic Chemistry (official prerequisite, GTU syllabus DI05005011)
prerequisites.gu: Unit Operations અને Basic Chemistry (સત્તાવાર prerequisite, GTU syllabus DI05005011)

title.en: Equipment for Gas Liquid Operations
title.gu: Gas Liquid Operations માટેના સાધનો

topics: 1.2 Classification of Equipment for Gas-Liquid Operations: 1.2.1 Gas Dispersed (Mechanically Agitated Vessel, Tray Tower), 1.2.2 Liquid Dispersed (Spray Tower, Packed Tower) — Construction & Working
1.4 Operating Problems of Tray Tower and Packed Tower
1.5 Real Tray & Tray efficiency — Point Efficiency, Murphree Efficiency, Overall Tray efficiency

title.en: Distillation
title.gu: Distillation (નિસ્યંદન)

topics: 2.2 Vapor Liquid Equilibria: constant pressure, constant temperature

2.7 Methods of Distillation: 2.7.1 Flash Vaporization (material balance & calculation), 2.7.2 Differential Distillation (Rayleigh's equation derivation & calculation), 2.7.3 Continuous Rectification of Binary Solution
2.8 McCabe-Thiele Method: derivation of enriching & stripping section lines, stepwise procedure, calculation of number of trays
2.9 Introduction of Feed and Location of the feed
2.11 Other Distillation Techniques: steam, vacuum, azeotropic, extractive

title.en: Humidification
title.gu: Humidification (ભેજીકરણ)

topics: 3.2 Saturated and Unsaturated Vapor Gas Mixtures
3.3 Absolute Humidity, Relative Saturation, Percentage Saturation, Dew Point, Dry Bulb Temperature, Wet Bulb Temperature, Adiabatic Saturation Temperature, Humid Volume, Humid Heat, Enthalpy
3.4 Calculations of Absolute Humidity, Relative Saturation and Percentage Saturation
3.6 Purposes of Contact of Gas with Pure Liquid
3.7 Equipments: Cooling Towers (natural & mechanical draft), Spray Chamber
3.8 Range, Approach and Cycle of Concentration for Cooling Tower

title.en: Drying
title.gu: Drying (સૂકવણી)

topics: 4.2 Definitions and Calculation of Moisture Content (wet and dry basis), Equilibrium and Free Moisture, Bound and Unbound moisture
4.4 Construction and Working of Drying Equipment: Tray Drier, Vacuum Drier, Rotary Drier, Spray Drier (syllabus numbering 4.7.1-4.7.4)
4.5 The Rate of Batch Drying — Derivation and Calculations: Constant Rate Period, Falling Rate Period (syllabus numbering 4.8.1-4.8.2)

title.en: Adsorption and Ion Exchange
title.gu: Adsorption અને Ion Exchange

topics: 5.1 Definition and Industrial Application of Adsorption
5.3 Nature of Adsorbents and Commonly Used Adsorbents
5.7 Freundlich's Adsorption Isotherm: equation for single stage operation, material balance (syllabus numbering 5.8.1-5.8.2)
5.8 Equipment: Higgins Contactor, Pressure Swing Adsorber (syllabus numbering 5.9.1-5.9.2)

title.en: Crystallization
title.gu: Crystallization (સ્ફટિકીકરણ)

topics: 6.5 Crystallization Equipment: Vacuum Crystallizer, Swenson Walker Crystallizer
6.8 Caking Of Crystals and Its Prevention

course_outcomes.en: CO1: Apply fundamental concepts of mass transfer operations in engineering problems (RBT: R, U, A)
course_outcomes.gu: CO1: Mass transfer operations ના મૂળભૂત ખ્યાલો engineering problems માં લાગુ કરો (RBT: R, U, A)

course_outcomes.en: CO2: Analyze the working principles and applications of various mass transfer equipment (RBT: R, U, A)
course_outcomes.gu: CO2: વિવિધ mass transfer equipment ના કાર્ય સિદ્ધાંતો અને ઉપયોગોનું વિશ્લેષણ કરો (RBT: R, U, A)

course_outcomes.en: CO3: Compute material balance for mass transfer processes under different operating conditions (RBT: A)
course_outcomes.gu: CO3: જુદી operating conditions હેઠળ mass transfer processes માટે material balance ગણો (RBT: A)

source_discrepancies: Unit 4 equipment items are numbered 4.7.1-4.7.4 and drying-rate items 4.8.1-4.8.2 in the official PDF although they sit under 4.4 and 4.5; contents recorded with the mapping stated.
Unit 5 single-stage items are numbered 5.8.1-5.8.2 and equipment 5.9.1-5.9.2 in the official PDF; contents recorded with the mapping stated.
Unit 6 lists both Vacuum Crystallizer and Swenson Walker Crystallizer under 6.5.1 in the official PDF.
The official name is printed 'Meir's Theory' (commonly Mier's theory of supersaturation); recorded as printed.
